quote: Fees Charged May – September, Weather Dependent
remark: Seasons of Use line; month-only 'September' close matches the chip's month, so confirms by rule, but read as 09-30 it is ~20 days past the chip's 09-10. The campground has first-come sites (rec.gov: 'FIRST COME FIRST SERVE sites must be booked in person'), so 09-10 looks like the end of reservations. Chip has no open edge; agency states May.

quote: Early July (weather dependent) - Early October (weather dependent)
remark: Seasons of Use line. 'Early October' set as 10-10 (the month-only rule would give 10-31); 'Early July' as 07-01. The same page's description says 'Open season is early June to early October' (conflicting open edge). rec.gov: 'This campground will have a mix of reservation sites and first-come, first-served sites for the 2026 season.' Calendar close 09-12 is the end of reservations. Off-scope: page says 'Can accommodate trailers up to 22 feet' (note says ~25 ft). | Applied closes only: the page gives two different openings (early June / early July). --Claude

Seasons of Use line; close month matches. Chip close 09-07 is Labor Day (holiday-anchored), so it may be the reservation end rather than the close. Page also: 'This campground remains open as weather and road conditions permit access. Visitors should be aware that no fees are charged and no amenities, facilities, or services are provided throughout the winter months.' Chip has no open edge; agency states June.

quote: Open July through September, weather permitting.
remark: Operational Hours line (Seasons of Use: 'July - September'); close month matches. Chip close 09-07 is Labor Day (holiday-anchored). Chip has no open edge; agency states July.

Operational Hours line; Seasons of Use: 'Mid July (Weather dependent) - Early October (weather dependent)'. Page: 'There are also sites for first come, first served.' Calendar close 09-12 is the end of reservations. Off-scope: page says 'Camping trailer has a maximum length of 22 feet.'

Seasons of Use line reads only 'Memorial Day' (holiday-anchored); chip 05-22 within 10 days. No close stated. BOOKING CONFLICT: entry booking has no fcfs, but the page says 'Some campsites in this location use the Scan and Pay feature. These campsites may not be reserved in advance but may only be reserved once you are physically on-site, on a first-come, first-served basis.'

quote: Open mid-June (weather permitting), gates close for the winter Mid September)
remark: Operational Hours line; 'mid' read as the 15th. Chip close 09-07 (Labor Day, holiday-anchored) is 8 days before mid-September. Page also says it 'remains open as weather and road conditions permit access' with no fees or services in winter. Chip has no open edge; agency states mid-June.

FS page has no Seasons of Use / Operational Hours line (only 'Potable water is typically available in this campground from July to September', a water season). rec.gov facility 10250594 text states no season (says mix of reservable and FCFS sites for 2026). Forest conditions and camping-cabins pages list no opening dates.

FS page has no Seasons of Use / Operational Hours line. rec.gov facility 231846 text states no season (water 'from July to September'; mix of reservable and FCFS sites for 2026). Forest conditions page lists no dates.
